Name: Current target HP
Description: HP of the living enemy currently selected by automatic targeting or manual lock-on. Unsupported or stale targets show no value.

Evidence.Finding: Player lock-on structure, packed target, active actor list and status backlink.

Name: Target maximum HP
Description: Maximum HP of the current living enemy.

Evidence.Finding: Enemy status current HP +0 and maximum +4.

Name: Target revenge value
Description: Current revenge accumulation. Available only for validated enemy actors; some enemies use additional scripted rules.

Evidence.Finding: Enemy float +3400 accumulates attack parameter +42 and is compared for the revenge event.

Name: Target revenge threshold
Description: The enemy's native revenge threshold. The trainer does not change this threshold.

Evidence.Finding: Enemy float +3404 starts at 100, can be set by scripts, and is compared with the current value.

Name: Refill locked enemy HP
Description: Restore the manually locked living enemy's HP to its maximum. Does not resurrect enemies or reset their AI, timers, phases, or rewards.

Evidence.Finding: Validated nonlethal update to current HP only. Manual lock state 2 is required.

Name: Reset locked enemy revenge
Description: Set the manually locked enemy's current revenge value to zero once. Does not cancel a revenge action that has already started.

Evidence.Finding: Only current enemy float +3400 changes; native threshold and AI remain unchanged.

Name: Set locked enemy revenge
Description: Set current revenge accumulation to practice the native threshold response. Requires a living enemy in manual lock-on.

Evidence.Finding: The event handler triggers revenge when the enemy's current value reaches its threshold.

Name: Targeting mode
Description: 0: none; 1: automatic target; 2: manual lock-on; 3: special targeting. Enemy actions require mode 2.

Name: Block player HP damage
Description: Block negative HP changes before the supported player's native HP callback subtracts them. Healing still works. Hit reactions, status effects, direct script writes, and scripted death paths remain active. Turns off after a player or scene change or connection loss.
RestoreBehavior: Restores the original callback only if the trainer still owns its slot. No HP floor or save data is modified.

Evidence.Finding: Exact callback replacement using compare-and-swap; only negative main-HP deltas for the validated current player are suppressed.

Name: Blocked HP changes
Description: Number of negative main-HP callback changes blocked since the damage guard was last enabled. This counts callback operations, not necessarily individual attacks.

Evidence.Finding: Trainer counter increments only when the guarded negative HP callback is suppressed.

Name: Last blocked HP amount
Description: Magnitude of the last negative main-HP callback suppressed by the damage guard.

Evidence.Finding: Signed 32-bit delta magnitude is widened before negation.

Name: Set locked enemy HP
Description: Set the manually locked living enemy's HP above zero, at least its native HP floor, and no higher than its maximum. Native phase scripts may react to the new HP. Does not award a kill or resurrect an enemy.

Evidence.Finding: Current HP is changed nonlethally; death and reward callbacks are not invoked.
